name: Backbone Fine-tuning
definition: Optimizing the weights of the pre-trained 3D generator (backbone) alongside the decoder to adapt tri-plane features for Gaussian Splatting attributes, which have scale and rotation influencing adjacent regions unlike NeRF's local color/density.
summary: Backbone Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained 3D generator's weights to support Gaussian Splatting, differing from other methods by modifying the generative prior rather than just the optimization trajectory.
